headline: Highest risk is data leakage and cascading error: Perplexity can browse/upload documents while ComfyUI is offline-only, so the pair is mainly exposed when users bridge outputs manually or via shared files.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ComfyUI has no filesystem read, clipboard, MCP, or browser ingestion, so it cannot be directly hijacked by Perplexity outputs. The only plausible bridge is manual copy-paste or shared files, which is unusual and limited. Perplexity’s browsing can produce untrusted text, but the pair lacks a default shared channel.
conditions: IF the operator manually pastes Perplexity output into a ComfyUI workflow or prompt field
IF a shared file export/import step is added between the agents
mitigations: Avoid copy-pasting Perplexity text into ComfyUI prompts
Use a plain-text sanitizer before any manual transfer
Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Label imported text as untrusted
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging on transferred artifacts

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity can analyze uploaded PDFs/images and browsing context, while ComfyUI touches local models and workflow assets but has no file read or network upload path from host files. There is no default shared workspace or host execution, so leakage requires an explicit manual bridge. The blast radius is limited to whatever the operator transfers.
conditions: IF the operator uploads ComfyUI-generated images, workflows, or model metadata into Perplexity
IF Perplexity browsing context includes sensitive content that is then copied into ComfyUI artifacts
mitigations: Do not upload sensitive ComfyUI artifacts to Perplexity
Strip metadata from images before upload
Use separate accounts for each agent
Review uploads for secrets before sending
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on manual uploads

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ComfyUI cannot write files, modify git, or spawn subprocesses, and Perplexity likewise has no host filesystem write or git access. With no overlapping write surface to the same mutable resource, there is no capability conflict pathway in the default pair. The interaction is effectively read-only/manual.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator grants both agents write access to the same directory
IF a separate toolchain maps Perplexity outputs into files that ComfyUI also edits
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only relative to shared assets
Do not mount a shared writable directory
Separate git repositories per agent
Use manual review before any file write
requires-engineering: add locking if a shared workspace is introduced

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity can generate cited answers from browsing, and ComfyUI can consume prompts or workflows derived from those answers if the operator forwards them. That creates a default human-mediated cascade where unverified claims can become inputs to image generation decisions. ComfyUI does not verify provenance, while Perplexity’s outputs may be treated as authoritative.
conditions: IF Perplexity output is copied into ComfyUI prompts or workflow parameters without review
IF generated citations are treated as factual ground truth for downstream creative or operational decisions
mitigations: Require human review of Perplexity claims before reuse
Keep a checklist for source verification
Annotate copied text with origin and timestamp
Use a separate draft step before ComfyUI execution
requires-engineering: add provenance checks to the workflow pipeline

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted and processes search queries, uploaded documents, and browsing context, while ComfyUI is offline-first and touches local media/model files. The pair can create compliance issues only if the operator moves regulated data into Perplexity; ComfyUI itself does not add a residency or retention mismatch. The other agent is cited because the risk arises from their combined data flow.
conditions: IF regulated documents or personal data are uploaded to Perplexity
IF the operator expects local-only handling but forwards the same data into vendor-hosted search
mitigations: Do not upload regulated data to Perplexity
Use redacted copies for search
Keep ComfyUI assets local-only
Check retention settings before upload
requires-engineering: route regulated workflows to a compliant environment
